Following a young Haymitch Abernathy in the brutal 50th Hunger Games, the film promises heart-pounding tension and deadly stakes, where the odds have never been more unforgiving. Based on Suzanne Collins' new novel, the prequel also dives deep into Panem’s dark history, offering a fresh look at the origins of the Games. Get ready for the Reaping.
